notes.title: Update 0.8.0
notes.content:
CHANGELOG:

New:

Forest Dungeon Replaces Random Battles.
New Sprites, You can catch them! but they will activally avoid you!
New Chests
New Item "Spirit" Which gives you 2x exp for one battle
Settings Menu
Added a button in options to fix corrupted saves from previous versions
Json Save Files

Fixes and Changes:
Z now appears on the Textbox
Saving is more optimised
Neru has Returned.
If the Menu has somehow despawned, it will now respawn itself seemlessly. No more missing menus!
The deck menu will no longer let you go with fewer than 5 cards.
The deck menu will warn you audiably if you try to leave with fewer than 5 cards.



Known Issue:
Invisible Blade/ Combo Blade still have no attack

notes.title: Sealer Assist Interactive Monster Update
notes.content:
Full patchnotes 
[code]

                          [          Bug Fixes        ]
               You can No longer get soft locked at the first Inn.
                  You can No longer get soft locked at the Act 1 Boss.
          The Mountain Zone is Locked until entering the Town.
          Crossbow no longer shows Del Tor's wand Text
          You can no longer accidently unlock more than is intended
          The shop used to sell too many cards (including Tier 3 cards in a tier 0 zone)
          Music NO longer Plays Double in every battle.
          The Wolfrun Inn no longer spams music.
          Engulf no longer locks you into forever transforming into engulf.
          
        
                                    [            New            ]

          Monsters now have Interactive attacks
          Music By LonelyLeppy
          

                                    [          Changed          ]    
          Goblins Damage has been scaled from 25 to 15
          Jailed Goblins have been scaled from 35 to 19
          The `Buy Potion` and `Stat` button have been implemented Into the shop system.
          The Wall Climb in the Mines is now a toggle instead of static up and down.
          Pressing `I` Will Open and close the inventory system
          Transition Effect added
          Goblin Grunt Sprites Changed and updated
         The battlesystem has been Completely Recoded.
        The Dialog System has been Recoded.
[10:32 PM]
                                    [          Removed          ]
          Old Shop remnants
          Ladder Climbing Sounds
                The Seed Dungeon has been Disabled for now. Will Return soon With new Coding.

                                    [          Planned          ]
         Side Areas to every zone, More side quests
                Act 2 (Snowfell) and 3 (Void & Volcane) are on the way.
                  More Cards are always planned (even after I finish)
         

                                   [          Known Bugs       ]
          Casey Refuses to give you his quest sometimes ( //Null )
          Some Areas will not play the transition effect.
"        Thunder & Light Arrow Sometimes Flip flop between their Sprites. (this is due to them sharing code, i will need to seperate them)
[/code]
